claims.text: Adult analgesic dose: 400 mg every 4 to 6 hours as needed for pain.
claims.quote: 400 mg every 4 to 6 hours as necessary for relief of pain.
claims.locator: Dosage and Administration › Mild to moderate pain

claims.quote: Ibuprofen produced an elevation of plasma lithium levels and a reduction in renal lithium clearance
Thus, when ibuprofen and lithium are administered concurrently, subjects should be observed carefully for signs of lithium toxicity.
This may indicate that they could enhance the toxicity of methotrexate.

claims.text: CI: asthma, urticaria or allergic-type reactions after aspirin or other NSAIDs.
claims.quote: Ibuprofen tablets should not be given to patients who have experienced asthma, urticarial, or allergic-type reactions after taking aspirin or other NSAIDs.
